# The orchestra and the band — licences

made mono and encoded as MP3 by `tools/fetch-orchestra.js`. All of it is
dedicated to the public domain under **Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal**
by its makers:

- 1958 Otto Rubner double bass, D. Smolken
- Versilian Community Sample Library (VCSL), Versilian Studios
- VSCO-2 Community Edition, Versilian Studios
- Virtuosity Drums, Versilian Studios
- Swirly Drums, Karoryfer Samples

Sources:
- VSCO-2 Community Edition, Versilian Studios: https://github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE
- Versilian Community Sample Library (VCSL), Versilian Studios: https://github.com/sgossner/VCSL
- Virtuosity Drums, Versilian Studios: https://github.com/sfzinstruments/virtuosity_drums
- Swirly Drums, Karoryfer Samples: https://github.com/sfzinstruments/karoryfer.swirly-drums
- 1958 Otto Rubner double bass, D. Smolken: https://github.com/sfzinstruments/dsmolken.double-bass

CC0 asks for nothing; the credit is given because it is owed.
